Package com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.events

Class OrderEventPublisher

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.events.OrderEventPublisher
@Component public class OrderEventPublisher extends Object
Publishes an OrderCompletedEvent to Kafka once an order reaches its final status. Callers publish only after the transaction that finished the order has committed, so an order that rolled back is never reported, and they pass the order as it now stands. Nothing here throws: the trade is already committed and must still succeed, so a failure to publish (broker down, account not found) is logged and the event is lost. The send waits at most max.block.ms for the broker, so a Kafka outage can't hold up an order response for long.
